frame_convention: frames 0..N inclusive at 30 fps, duration = N / 30 s; loops repeat frame 0 at N
units: Blender metres / Unreal centimetres; root motion only on dash_* (2 m nominal)

clips.notes: deliberate successful release: final push then relax

clips.required_behavior: Wind up and accumulate energy.

clips.required_behavior: Forceful release with weight transfer.
